name: Guard acceptance 3 min
description: Short profile for ticket 0008 acceptance: verify the heater guard auto-arms and survives the run being killed. rpm 0 throughout and no temperature schedule, so the run needs neither the VFD nor the Omron — it tests the guard, not the rig. SP/CHAN3 volt_offset is 5.0 because the slip ring sits on its ~5 V excitation pedestal; measured 2026-08-29 the channel spans 1.8-8.4 V. The old 8.0/0.0 window (-4 to +4 V) clipped more than half of it. Runs before 2026-08-29 were taken with the scope probe's GROUND LEAD DETACHED, which removed the DC reference and is why SP looked like it sat at 0 V and carried no rotation signal - see ticket 0038.
